title: Per-role comparison table
description: Aggregates eval result rows (result-row.schema.json, plan §8 field list) into one table per role, with one cell per (model, driver, variant) identity. Axis 1 (ADR-0001, revised 2026-09-14) populates cells with driver "ai-sdk" across models; axis 2 populates cells with the fixed served GLM model id (glm-5.3-flash) across all four drivers. All model ids in cells are served ids per the served-id decision (2026-09-14).

role.description: The plan §9 role whose result rows this table aggregates.

suite.description: Name of the task suite the aggregated rows came from (the `name` field of a suite.schema.json document).

generatedAt.description: When the table was generated (RFC 3339 date-time).

cells.description: One cell per (model, driver, variant) identity with at least one result row; an empty suite yields an empty-but-valid table (cells: []) — the J2 runner's conformance property.

model.description: Served model id of the rows in this cell (served-id decision 2026-09-14).

driver.description: The toolkit driver lane of the rows in this cell (ADR-0001).

runs.description: Number of result rows aggregated into this cell.

passed.description: Scoring probes passed, summed over the cell's rows.

total.description: Scoring probes total, summed over the cell's rows (each row requires outcome.total >= 1, so an aggregate of 0 is unreachable).

score.description: Aggregate score for the cell: passed/total.

invalid.description: P5 validity marker propagated from the contributing rows. Scores are retained unchanged but must not be published as a valid model result.

costUSD.description: Aggregate cost in USD over the cell's runs, or null when the lane is subscription-metered and has no per-invocation USD (DD-9, 2026-09-14).

costBasis.description: Optional basis of a non-null costUSD, mirroring the toolkit's WorkerResult.costBasis, so a modeled number is never silently reported as actual spend; forbidden when costUSD is null (DD-9).

wallTimeMs.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds, summed over the cell's runs.

tokens.description: Token usage summed over the cell's runs, same shape as a result row's tokens (ADR-0001 usage shape).

byVerdict.description: VERSIONED ADDITIVE change F4 (2026-09-21): per-verdict confusion counts, computed from the rows' probes[] (review-classifier cells only; absent on fixer cells and on all old tables by design). Exactly the five classifyThreads verdict keys; each value carries the expected count, the correct count (observed === expected), and the predicted buckets for in-vocabulary observed verdicts (a null or out-of-vocabulary observed is a miss with no predicted bucket).

expected.description: Rows whose probe expected this verdict.

correct.description: Rows whose observed verdict equaled the expected verdict.

predicted.description: Counts per observed (predicted) verdict among rows expecting this verdict's key — in-vocabulary observed verdicts only.

macroF1.description: VERSIONED ADDITIVE change F4 (2026-09-21): mean of the five per-verdict F1 scores derived from byVerdict (per-verdict F1 = 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), 0 when the denominator is 0). Absent wherever byVerdict is absent.

fpRate.description: VERSIONED ADDITIVE change F4 (2026-09-21): fraction of the cell's suspicious-benign rows (row suspiciousBenign === true) whose probe OBSERVED actionable — i.e. the classifier cried wolf on adjudicated-benign content. A benign row missed with any other observed verdict (or a null observed) is a miss, not a false positive. Omitted with fpN when the subset is empty.

fpN.description: VERSIONED ADDITIVE change F4 (2026-09-21): denominator of fpRate — the count of suspicious-benign rows in this cell. Omitted when zero.

variant.description: VERSIONED ADDITIVE change F6 (2026-09-21): the prompt/tool-surface bundle id that distinguishes this cell. Omitted for the default posture, so pre-F6 tables and default cells keep their shape. Cells are unique on (model, driver, variant).

scoreCI.description: VERSIONED ADDITIVE change F6 (2026-09-21): Wilson score interval for the cell's score at 95% confidence, emitted only when the cell's probe total n >= 30 (below that the interval is too wide to be evidence). Absent on old tables and on small-n cells.

allOf.description: ADR-0001 eval axes enforced per cell (revised 2026-09-14): axis 1 — models vary on the ai-sdk driver; axis 2 — drivers vary on the fixed GLM served id glm-5.3-flash (served-id decision 2026-09-14). A cell on any non-ai-sdk driver must therefore carry exactly the fixed GLM served id.
